other_conditions: Must be a registered company in Kerala as an LLP or Private Limited company.
Must have active registration with Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM) at the time of application.
Must have DIPP registration and an “Active” or “Active Compliant” status with the MCA.
Must have no pending dues with any government agencies, KSUM, or other incubators in the state, and must not be blacklisted by any government agency in India.
Women co‑founder must hold a majority stake in the startup.
Technology or license must be sourced from any government research institution in India, with a fee payable to the institution.
The startup must commercialize the product within two years of acquiring the license/technology.
If commercialization is not achieved within two years, the startup must repay the contribution received from KSUM.
The startup must sign an agreement with Kerala Startup Mission before availing the benefit.
benefits_summary: Funding support up to ₹10 Lakhs, reimbursing up to 90 % of the technology fee paid to the research institution.
